blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The pursuit of fair and equitable AI in human-centric tasks is critically hindered by the inherent biases and privacy risks of real-world datasets, which offer imbalanced representations of identity and often contain sensitive personal information. Consequently, state-of-the-art generative models trained on this skewed data exhibit unfair performance, particularly in identity-preserving generation. In this work we propose a pipeline for controllable generation of dataset with diverse faces for generative models training and finetuning. We achieve this by expanding foundational Arc2Face diffusion model with a flow matching generative model in the manifold of identity embeddings. We demonstrate that such approach achieves both goals of generative fidelity and label diversity not present in real human-centric datasets. As a result we collect and further contextualize a highly balanced identity-centric dataset of humans named SynthFaces. By design, our released images and identities are synthetic, reducing direct reliance on real personal images; we empirically check identity separation with a nearest-neighbor non-leakage metric. We purpose it for training and tuning of fair models for various downstream tasks, and showcase its usability in finetuning an existing adapter-based method for personalized generation.
blocks.zh: 现实世界数据集的固有偏见和隐私风险严重地阻碍了在以人为中心的任务中实现公正和平等的AI,这些数据提供了身份的不平衡表述,并往往包含敏感的个人信息。 因此,在这种扭曲的数据方面受过培训的最先进的基因模型显示出不公平的表现,特别是在保存身份方面。 在这项工作中,我们提议为基因模型的培训和微调提供一个可控数据集的管道,其面孔多种多样。 我们通过扩展基础Arc2Face扩散模型来实现这一点,在身份嵌入的多面体中用流相匹配的基因模型. 我们表明,这种做法既能实现基因忠诚的目标,又能实现真正以人为中心的数据集中没有的标签多样性的目标。 因此,我们收集和进一步将一个高度平衡的、以身份为中心的名为合成花样的人类数据集联系起来。 通过设计,我们释放的图像和身份是被合成的,减少了对真实个人图像的直接依赖;我们以经验来检查身份分离,用最近的邻居非漏出度量衡. 我们的目的是培训和调整各种下游任务的公平模式,并展示其可用性,以微调一种基于适应器的现有个人化生成方法。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Human image generation is one of the most common applications of modern generative models. The field originated with unconditional generators such as StyleGAN [ 4 ] , which allowed to sample novel faces without any control, and was later expanded to text-to-image diffusion models and adapter-based approaches (e.g., PhotoMaker, SDXL-based personalization), which allow conditioning on a novel face from a single image [ 28 , 36 , 21 , 32 ] and combined with prompt allowed to place human in different context. Unfortunately, most released face-conditional models report averaged quality, which conceals an important aspect of such methods - do they perform equally for different human subgroups ? In this work we show that this is not the case, and try to address this problem with our curated dataset SynthFaces collected with focus on balanced human representation.
blocks.zh: 人类图像生成是现代基因模型最常用的应用之一. 球场起源于StyleGAN [4]等无条件的生成器,允许在没有任何控制的情况下对小说面部进行取样,后来被扩展为文本到图像的传播模型和以适配器为基础的方法(如PhotoMaker,SDXL基于个性化),允许从单一的图像上对一出小说面部进行调节[28,36,21,32],并与被允许将人置于不同上下文的即时进行组合. 不幸的是,大多数发布的面额条件模型都报告平均质量,这掩盖了这类方法的一个重要方面——它们是否对不同的人类分组同样发挥作用? 在这项工作中,我们表明情况并非如此,并试图用我们收集的以平衡的人类代表性为重点的综合数据组来解决这一问题。

blocks.en: SynthFaces dataset collection pipeline is designed to address a set of three core problems. 1) Label bias of existing datasets: both existing datasets with human faces, such as FFHQ, SHHQ [ 4 ] , EasyPortrait [ 15 ] and CosmicMan-HQ [ 19 ] and generative samplers exhibit severe category imbalance - both unconditional samplers such as StyleGAN [ 25 ] , as well as by conditional samplers e.g., Arc2Face [ 26 ] , PhotoMaker [ 21 ] produce or reflect skewed distributions over demographic attributes (age, race, gender). 2) Face-similarity quality of conditional samplers: when evaluated per demographic group, conditional personalization models show uneven face preservation quality, which is natural given first problem; 3) Usage of real people identities: existing real datasets, especially large-scale ones, may include identities that did not give consent for deep learning model training or may include identities from under-age groups, using which may be completely unethical and certain datasets have been revoked from public access for that reason [ 13 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 合成Faces数据集采集管道旨在解决一组三个核心问题. 1) 现有数据集的标签偏差:既有带有人脸的数据集,如FFHQ,SHHQ [4],EasyPortrait [15]和CosmicMan-HQ [19] 以及基因取样器都表现出严重的类别不平衡——既有StyleGAN [25]等无条件的采样器,也有有条件的采样器,如Arc2Face [26],PhotoMaker [21]产生或反映人口属性(年龄,种族,性别)的扭曲分布. 2)有条件采样员的相像质量:在按人口组别进行评估时,有条件的个性化模型显示出面相保存质量不均匀,这是自然的第一问题;3)真实人身份的用法:现有真实数据集,特别是大型数据集,可能包括不同意深层学习模式培训的身份,也可能包括来自未成年组别的身份,使用这些身份可能完全不道德,某些数据集也因此被取消公众访问权[13,7].

blocks.en: Additionally, we aim to fulfill properties that are largely required for modern human-centric datasets - such properties are mentioned in Table 1 , specifically we aim to provide Captions for images, describing both humans and surrounding context, collected images are ID-grouped , meaning that there are multiple images with same person, and lastly we aim to obtain HQ image with high resolution. These properties may be missing for certain types of datasets mentioned in table. For example under Raw Images we denote large-scale raw collections obtained via web-scrapping, are large enough to include all types of faces, however they might still require label-balancing strategy, as well image filtering to obtain high-quality images. HQ Captioned datasets are high quality, but they balance in human representation as we show later, as well as typically do not include multiple images of same person. Face Recognition datasets are typically also without captions, low resolution and also skewed in terms of human representation. In comparison our collected dataset satisfies all of these properties, while also using released images and identities that are synthetic and empirically screened for identity separation.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们的目标是实现现代人本数据集基本需要的特性——这些特性在表1中提及,具体地说,我们的目的是为图像提供说明,描述人类和周围环境,收集的图像是ID分组的,这意味着有多个图像与同一个人在一起,最后我们的目标是获得高分辨率的总部图像。 这些属性可能因表格中提及的某些类型的数据集而缺失. 例如,在Raw Images下,我们表示通过网络扫描获得的大规模原始收藏,足够大,足以包括所有类型的面相,但是它们可能仍然需要标签平衡策略,以及图像过滤以获得高质量的图像. HQ Captioned data sets是高品质的,但它们在我们稍后显示的人类代表性方面是平衡的,而且通常不包括同一人的多幅图像. 脸部识别数据集一般也没有标题,分辨率低,在人的代表性方面也存在偏差. 相比之下,我们收集的数据集满足了所有这些特性,同时也使用了已释放的图像和身份,这些图像和身份经过合成和实证筛选,以便进行身份分离。

blocks.en: SynthFaces addresses these problems by introducing controllable label diversity into identity representation sampling and by releasing synthetic identities whose separation from real training identities is checked through ID-NonLeak. The resulting dataset is balanced across selected demographic labels, ID-grouped, captioned, and contextualized for high-resolution human generation. We systematically study label balance, non-leakage, image quality, and downstream usefulness through generative fine-tuning, face recognition fairness, and demographic VQA in Section 5 .

blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: have been studied primarily for face recognition [ 14 , 1 , 18 ] . Existing pipelines combine GAN samples with per-identity adaptation [ 15 , 29 ] , or exploit the conditional space of face foundation models such as Arc2Face [ 26 ] . HyperFace [ 30 ] explores this hyperspherical space directly, but its generated identities remain demographically imbalanced. Arc2Face and Vec2Face [ 34 ] instead perturb real ArcFace embeddings with PCA, requiring real identity embeddings at inference time and offering no explicit separation from them. ID-Flow learns a controllable prior over the identity manifold, samples without reference embeddings at inference time, and evaluates separation using ID-NonLeak (Table 2 ).

blocks.en: Identity-preserving generation conditions image synthesis on a reference face. Introduced with adapter-based methods - IP-Adapter-FaceID [ 36 ] , PhotoMaker [ 21 ] , PuLID [ 8 ] , and InstantID [ 32 ] ; InfiniteYou [ 11 ] further improves fidelity and flexibility. blocks.zh: 3. 动机

blocks.en: 3.1 Existing datasets biases
blocks.zh: 3.1 现有数据集偏差

blocks.en: To quantify label bias in existing datasets, we annotate them with FairFace classifier [ 12 ] and in Figure 1 show that all of the presented datasets demonstrate heavy bias towards certain labels. Training on such data without empirical balancing strategies can be harmful for generative model fairness and diversity.
blocks.zh: 为了量化现有数据集中的标签偏差,我们用FairFace分级器[12]进行注释,并在图1中显示,所有提交的数据集都表现出对某些标签的强烈偏差. 没有经验平衡战略的这类数据培训可能不利于遗传模型的公平和多样性。

blocks.zh: 3.2 国家 评价以人为中心的模式中的不公平性

blocks.en: 4 Dataset construction
blocks.zh: 4 数据集构建

blocks.en: In order to build a dataset of synthetic released identities and images, we follow a 3 stage design described in Figure 2 . Each stage is motivated by a specific problem of existing pipelines - at stage 1 we ensure that dataset is private while also free of skewed label distribution, at stage 2 we construct maximum fidelity faces from diverse identity representation, and at stage 3 we achieve high resolution and context coupled with captions.
blocks.zh: 为了建立合成释放身份和图像数据集,我们遵循图2所描述的3个阶段设计。 每个阶段都受现有管道的具体问题所驱使——在第一阶段,我们确保数据集是私有的,同时不带扭曲的标签分布;在第二阶段,我们从各种身份代表中构建出最大限度的忠诚面孔;在第三阶段,我们实现了高分辨率和上下文并配有标题。

blocks.en: 4.1 Learning to sample identities
blocks.zh: 4.1 学习抽样身份

blocks.en: We compare against other baselines in terms of a) face image quality b) label diversity. In Table 2 these baselines are: parameter-free or naive such as uniform sampling on sphere, interpolation of embeddings and PCA based sampling, following procedure described in [ 34 ] , unconditional StyleGAN and conditional model -based samplers - Arc2Face and Photomaker that were used with synthetic identities, as well as recent HyperFace method for synthetic generation. We report image FID (FID-i) with face hold-out set, and generative metrics for identity latents (FID in embedding space (FID-e), Precision, Recall, F1) [ 16 ] . During sampling with ID-flow we do not utilize labels from test set, but sample labels from train data statistics for fair comparison. ID-Flow gives the best FID-e, recall, F1, and ID-NonLeak among learned samplers, while keeping image FID close to Arc2Face.

blocks.en: Compared to other models, our method offers superior identity diversity, since other baseline samplers inherit mode collapse property of synthetic data. Despite strong results of interpolation, we show that it results in leakage of training data into samples (ID-NonLeak) - we measure identity leakage over the training set as an average cosine distance to nearest neighbor from training data - samples from model are almost orthogonal to closest samples from train data, while interpolated samples remain in close angular proximity.
blocks.zh: 与其他模型相比,我们的方法提供了优越的身份多样性,因为其他基准采样者继承了合成数据模式崩溃属性. 尽管内插取得了强有力的结果,但我们表明,它导致培训数据渗入样本(ID-Nonleak)——我们把培训组上的身份渗出作为培训数据与最近邻居的平均同位素距离——模型中的样本几乎正对地到火车数据中最接近的样本,而内插样本则保持近角相近。

blocks.en: we start by analyzing distribution of images characteristics generated by Arc2Face. We evaluate conventional computer vision characteristics of images, such as entropy and saturation . blocks.en: After basic image statistics filtering we utilize multiple Qwen-VL models to assess obtained images from two perspectives 1) does the person’s face align with labels that were used to generate them 2) does the person’s face contain any visual artifacts. Based of VLM answers we drop all misaligned images and images that contained faces with visual defects, keeping samples which by majority voting of VLMs are assessed as well-aligned. To make sure that only relevant artifacts are dropped, we prompted VLM to reason about noticed artifacts in the images and dropped images only if the reasoning contained specific key-words. Detailed example of VLM prompting is provided in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh: 在基本图像统计过滤后, 我们利用多个 Quen-VL 模型从两个角度评估获得的图像 1 , 人物的脸是否与用来生成图像的标签一致 2 , 人物的脸是否包含任何视觉文物 。 基于VLM的答案,我们放弃了所有含有视觉缺陷的相片和相片的错位,保留了样本,通过多数表决,VLM被评为吻合. 为了保证只丢下相关的文物,我们促使VLM对图像中被注意的文物进行推理,只有当推理中包含特定的关键词时才会丢出图像. 附录A.5提供了VLM提示的详细例子。

blocks.en: Additionally, we made sure that resulting identities are not only diverse in terms of labels, but also in terms of embeddings themselves. For that purpose we evaluated distribution of nearest neighbors in the resulting identities and observed a long tail which is not present in typical datasets. After per-label analysis these higher similarity tails occurred for specific label combinations that were particularly rare in training data used for ID-flow training - e.g. rare race groups or age groups. Therefore we filter by similarity threshold for these specific groups, while also keeping a proportion of data across labels close to uniform. After this stage with obtain highly diverse identities, superior to diversity in other baselines - 15 thousand filtered identities and respective labeled images remain. Detailed analysis of this stage results is given in Appendix A.4 . The overall image statistics before and after all filtering strategies applied at this stage are given in Table 4 . Filtering improves image quality metrics (FID e and FID i ) and removes visible artifacts, but it also reduces F1/precision/recall and worsens KL-age because the most problematic tails are not perfectly uniform distributed across demographic labels.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们确保由此产生的身份不仅在标签方面,而且在嵌入本身方面也各不相同。 为此,我们评估了最近邻国在所形成身份中的分布情况,并观察到了典型数据集中没有的一长尾巴。 经过每个标签分析后,这些较高的相似性尾巴发生于特定标签组合中,这些组合在ID-flow培训中使用的训练数据中尤为罕见——例如罕见的种族群体或年龄组. 因此,我们对这些特定群体采用相似性阈值进行过滤,同时使各标签的数据比例接近统一。 在这一阶段之后,获得高度多样化的特性,优于其他基线的多样性 -- -- 仍有15,000个被过滤的特性和相应的被标记的图像。 这一阶段结果的详细分析见附录A.4。 本阶段所有过滤战略前后的总体图像统计见表4。 过滤能改善图像质量度量(FID e和FID i)并去除可见的文物,但也会降低F1/精度/回溯并恶化KL-年龄,因为最有问题的尾巴并非完全统一地分布在人口标志上.

blocks.en: After filtering, we additionally test whether balanced prompting of a state-of-the-art text-to-image model can replace explicit identity-manifold sampling. blocks.en: In order to contextualize images, we collected captions of images from real world datasets like Cosmic-HQ and FFHQ-in-the-Wild and collections of human related texts like HumanCaption [ 2 ] . We filtered prompts to exclude any details related to attributes that were controlled during identity sampling, including details with description of facial features. After that we roughly annotated these captions into subgroups based of their context, main factor being suitable age, e.g. prompts for child, prompts for adults, etc. After that we randomly sampled captions for each image given its label, matching label with classes with captions that are suitable for these face label values by looking for specific keywords that were used as person descriptors. Details of algorithm are given in Appendix A.6 .
blocks.zh: 为了对图像进行背景化,我们收集了来自宇宙总部和FFHQ-in-Wild等真实世界数据集的图像字幕,并收集了HumanCaption等与人类相关的文本[2]. 我们过滤了提示,以排除与身份抽样过程中所控制的属性有关的任何细节,包括描述面部特征的细节. 之后,我们根据这些标题的背景,将这些标题概括为分组,主要因素是适龄,例如儿童提示、成人提示等。 之后,我们随机抽取了每个图像的标签标题,通过查找用作人名描述符的特定关键字,将标签与适合这些面额标签值的标签相匹配。 算法的细节见附录A.6.

blocks.en: In order to unite curated identities with captions, we utilize state of the art personalization models - InfiniteYou and in-context model Flux 2, first one aims for consistency while second one allows more fidelity and variability. In order to enhance realism of images generated with InfiniteYou we attach additional LoRAs for realism and deblurring, and to speed up generation with Flux 2 we utilize Turbo checkpoint that from experiments turned to be the best amongst existing models for personalized generation of humans, see qualitative comparison in Appendix A.7 . As a result, we obtain a large scale, high quality diverse dataset of synthetic released identities, consisting in total of 150,000 captioned high-resolution images of varying aspect ratios, with approximately 10 images per identity. blocks.en: 5 Downstream applications

blocks.en: We evaluate whether SynthFaces data yields fairness benefits in distinct downstream tasks: finetuning personalized generation pipeline, face recognition (FR) verification and demographic attribute classification. Fine-tuning tests usefulness for id-preserving generation, FR tests whether balanced synthetic identities reduce verification disparity, and VQA tests whether balanced human images help demographic attribute recognition.

This benchmark corresponds of to maximum reconstruction of person facial features. Second benchmark named Context is a less diverse in terms of labels, but includes richer prompts specializing in placing people in contexts, demonstrating trade-off between face similarity being lower for smaller faces and more contextualized humans.

blocks.en: Finetuning conditional diffusion model comes with a challenge of data distribution drift . It’s a problem that arises because of discrepancy between data that was used for training original checkpoint and data that is being used for finetuning. Main characteristic that seemingly may hurt performance of these methods in terms of face preservation is learned face size . Face size in collected data serves as hidden factor that can be learned by diffusion model and directly affect similarity metric. Therefore to mitigate effect of this hidden factor we apply approach from [ 5 ] termed shortcut finetuning - specifically we attach frozen ControlNet [ 37 ] to condition on human pose and face position in source image, making finetuned IP-adapter layers learn only essential features related to face preservation. Details about this approach and hyperparameters for training are given in Appendix A.8 .
blocks.zh: 微调有条件的传播模式带来数据分布漂移的挑战。 因为训练原始检查站所用的数据与用于微调的数据有出入, 保护脸部方面, 所收集的数据中的相貌大小是隐性因素,可以通过扩散模型学习,并直接影响相似度度量. 因此,为了减轻这一隐蔽因素的影响,我们采用了[5] 所谓的捷径微调方法 -- -- 具体地说,我们附加了被冻结的控制网[37],以适应人姿势和源图像中的脸部位置,使微调的IP适应器层只学习与保护脸部有关的基本特征。 附录A.8详细介绍了这一方法和培训超参数。

In Fig. 8 we showcase improvement across different label values per age and race groups - improvement is not isolated and ultimately makes performance more uniform. More detailed finetuning results with another personalized generation method are provided in Appendix A.8 .
blocks.zh: 我们为稳定分配提供微调结果,同时提供IPAdapter-FaceID。 我们看到公平面貌重建基准有了显著的改善,同时保持了符合具体情况的一代的可比业绩。 然而,检查每个标签的质量变化也很重要。 入法义. 8,我们展示每个年龄和种族群体不同标签值的改善----改进不是孤立的,最终使业绩更加统一。 附录A.8提供了使用另一种个性化生成方法进行更详细微调的结果。

blocks.en: 5.2 Face Recognition Fairness
blocks.zh: 5.2 脸部识别公平

blocks.en: We train FR model on a version of our synthetic dataset purposed for this task - we sample 500k images from ID-Flow + Arc2Face with uniform labels, 50 images per identity, and additionally filter identities by similarity threshold in every subgroup. We compare with two other available FR model baselines: SynthFaces-500K (IResNet-100, ArcFace, ∼ \sim 500K images of 10K identities from our pipeline), Vec2Face [ 34 ] (IResNet-50 SE, ArcFace, ∼ \sim 300K images, HSFace300K real-web source), and HyperFace [ 30 ] . We evaluate on two regimes: (a) five standard FR benchmarks (LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30, CALFW, CPLFW) annotated post-hoc with FairFace [ 12 ] demographic labels, and (b) BFW (Balanced Faces in the Wild) [ 27 ] , a balanced dataset with over ∼ \sim 900K images balanced across 4 races × \times 2 genders with human-assigned labels.
blocks.zh: 我们在为这项任务设计的合成数据集版本上训练FR模型——我们用统一的标签对ID-Flow + Arc2Face的500克图像进行取样,每个身份有50个图像,另外通过每个分组的类似阈值过滤身份。 我们比较了另外两个可用的FR模型基线:合成Faces-500K(IResNet-100,ArcFace, ∼ sim 500K图像来自我们的管道的10K身份),Vec2Face [34](IResNet-50 SE, ArcFace, ∼ sim 300K图像, HSFace300K real-web source),和HyperFace [30]. 我们评价两种制度:(a) 五个标准FR基准(LFW, CFP-FP, AgeDB-30, CALFW, CPLFW) 附加了FairFace[12]人口标签的附加说明后基准,以及(b) BFW(野生生物脸)[27],一个平衡的数据集,其中的相差超过900K的图像在4个种族之间保持了平衡 ××x=======================================================================================================================================================

blocks.en: We aim to evaluate fairness of trained FR models. After analyzing standard FR benchmarks we find them to be heavily skewed (AgeDB-30: 88% White; LFW: 66% White, 75% male - see Table 14 in the Appendix), making accuracy-disparity metrics conflate representation with bias. A face verification system accepts or rejects a pair against a threshold τ \tau ; the two governing error rates are the False Match Rate (FMR) and False Non-Match Rate (FNMR) [ 6 ] . We evaluate at a calibrated operating point: fix the global FMR to target α ∈ { 1 % , 0.1 % } \alpha\in\{1\%,0.1\%\} via τ α = Quantile α ​ ( { D i : y i = 0 } ) \tau_{\alpha}=\text{Quantile}_{\alpha}(\{D_{i}:y_{i}{=}0\}) , then measure per-group FNMR. This reflects realistic deployment where an operator fixes a tolerable false-alarm rate. To normalize for absolute model quality and isolate relative group (dis)advantage, we adopt the Skewed Error Ratio (SER), inspired by [ 31 ] : SER g ​ ( α ) = FNMR g ​ ( α ) FNMR global ​ ( α ) . \text{SER}_{g}(\alpha)=\frac{\text{FNMR}_{g}(\alpha)}{\text{FNMR}_{\text{global}}(\alpha)}. blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced SynthFaces, a large-scale, identity-grouped and captioned synthetic human dataset designed for demographic balance while reducing reliance on released images of real individuals. Its ID-Flow sampler provides explicit demographic control while maintaining identity diversity and empirical separation from the real identities used for training. Across personalized generation, face recognition, and demographic VQA, models trained with SynthFaces improve subgroup parity while retaining useful task performance. These results show that controlling identity composition during dataset construction is an effective lever for fairer human-centric models. Future work should reduce dependence on potentially biased face encoders and foundation generators and investigate hybrid real–synthetic balancing strategies.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍了SynthFaces,这是一个大规模、有身份组合和标题的合成人类数据集,旨在实现人口平衡,同时减少对真实个人释放图像的依赖。 它的ID-Flow取样器提供明确的人口控制,同时保持身份多样性和在经验上与用于培训的真正身份分离。 在整个个性化一代、面部识别和人口VQA中,接受合成法培训的模型提高了分组均等,同时保留了有用的任务业绩。 这些结果表明,在数据集构建过程中控制身份构成是更公平的以人为中心的模型的有效杠杆. 未来的工作应该减少对潜在有偏见的面相编码器和地基生成器的依赖,并调查混合实际-合成平衡策略。

blocks.en: 7 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 限制

blocks.en: While SynthFaces addresses key gaps in existing datasets, several limitations should be acknowledged.
blocks.zh: 虽然合成元数据处理现有数据集中的关键空白,但应承认若干局限性。

blocks.en: Arc2Face and Flux despite being state of the art generators for corresponding parts of pipeline carry aesthetic and demographic biases from their respective training corpora. Our pipeline guarantees label-level balance across age, race, and gender, but within-group visual diversity and image style remain bounded by what these upstream models can faithfully generate. Demographic combinations that are underrepresented in Arc2Face’s training data may yield lower-fidelity or less varied outputs.
blocks.zh: Arc2Face和Flux尽管是输油管相应部分的艺术发电机,但携带着来自各自训练的美学和人口偏见。 我们的管道保证了不同年龄、种族和性别的标签水平平衡,但群体内部的视觉多样性和图像风格仍然受到这些上游模型能够忠实产生的限制。 在Arc2Face的培训数据中代表性不足的人口组合,可能产生不太真实或不太多样化的产出。

blocks.en: Images produced by diffusion models may contain subtle distributional artifacts absent from real photographs. While our VLM-based filtering step removes overt defects, residual domain differences could limit transferability when SynthFaces-trained models are evaluated on real-world data.
blocks.zh: 由扩散模型所制作的图像可能含有真相中缺失的微妙的分布文物. 虽然我们基于VLM的过滤步骤消除了公开的缺陷,但当合成法训练模型在现实世界数据上得到评价时,剩余域差异可能会限制可转移性.

blocks.en: The expressive range of generated identities is ultimately constrained by Arc2Face’s capacity for identity preservation and Flux’s generation quality. Improvements to either foundation model would directly benefit downstream dataset quality, but also introduce a moving dependency.
blocks.zh: 生成身份的表达范围最终受到Arc2Face保存身份的能力和豪华的生成质量的限制. 改进其中任何一个基础模型将直接有利于下游数据集的质量,但也会产生移动的依赖性。

blocks.en: 8 Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 8 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The creation of SynthFaces is a direct response to the ethical crisis surrounding web-scraped human-centric datasets, many of which have been rightfully retracted due to non-consensual use of personal images, including those of minors. To reduce these privacy and consent risks, SynthFaces releases synthetic identities generated by our pipeline rather than scraped personal images. Because ID-Flow is trained from ArcFace embeddings extracted from real datasets, we do not claim a formal privacy guarantee; instead, we empirically evaluate nearest-neighbor separation with the ID-NonLeak metric and design the dataset to avoid direct re-use of real personal images.
blocks.zh: SynthFaces的创立是对围绕网络所围攻的以人为中心的数据集的伦理危机的直接反应,其中许多数据由于未经同意使用个人相片,包括未成年人相片而被正确收回. 为了减少这些隐私和同意风险,合成面孔释放出我们管道产生的合成身份,而不是被刮去的个人图像. 由于ID-Flow是从从真实数据集提取的ArcFace嵌入器中被训练出来的,所以我们并不主张正式的隐私保障;相反,我们经验性地评价了与ID-Nonleak度量衡最近的相邻分离,并设计了数据集以避免直接再使用真实的个人图像.

blocks.en: Furthermore, we address the issue of demographic bias that plagues both real and synthetic datasets. Our pipeline is explicitly designed to generate a balanced representation across age, gender, and ethnicity, creating a resource purposed for training fairer models and mitigating the harmful disparities common in existing technologies. While we acknowledge that no synthetic data is perfect and subtle biases may persist, we believe this work demonstrates a responsible path forward, decoupling progress in human-centric computer vision from the exploitation of personal data.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们处理困扰真实和合成数据集的人口偏见问题。 我们的管道明确旨在在年龄、性别和族裔之间产生均衡的代表性,为培训更公平的模式创造资源并缩小现有技术中常见的有害差距。 虽然我们承认,任何合成数据都不是完美的,而且可能继续存在微妙的偏见,但我们认为,这项工作显示了一条负责任的前进道路,使以人为中心的计算机远景的进展与利用个人数据脱钩。

blocks.en: Our training stage is conducted fully in latent space of ArcFace embedding. To obtain them, we first processed images from Cosmic-HQ, FFHQ, EasyPortait and also enriched with images of people from the internet. We included only embeddings that were detectable with fixed bounding box size set to 640, since embeddings tend to significantly differ depending on detection size. We implement a deduplication stage, where all collected embeddings are filtered out by a threshold value of 0.4 pairwise cosine similarity, ensuring diverse faces are used for training and avoiding identity collapse, where model learns only fixed amount of identities. Then we also annotate all collected images with FairFace, providing age/race/gender labels, and remove embeddings that correspond to images that failed labeling stage. As a result, we train on around 50k identity embeddings with labels. For evaluation we use hold-out set of Cosmic-HQ images and CelebA, which weren’t used during training, and apply same pipeline to obtain embeddings and labels, without deduplication stage.
blocks.zh: 我们的培训阶段完全在ArcFace嵌入的潜在空间进行。 我们首先从宇宙总部、FFHQ、EasyPortait处理图像, 我们只包括可探测到的嵌入物,固定边框大小设定为640个,因为嵌入物往往因探测大小而有显著差异。 我们实施一个分解阶段,所有所收集的嵌入物被0.4对等同位素相似性的阈值过滤出,确保使用不同的面孔来进行培训并避免身份崩溃,模型只学习固定数量的身份. 之后我们还用 FairFace 对所有收集的图像进行注释,提供年龄/种族/性别标签,并去除与标签失败的图像对应的嵌入. 因此,我们培训了大约50克的身份嵌入标签。 在评估时,我们使用在训练期间没有使用的Cosmic-HQ图像和CelebA,并采用同样的管道来获得嵌入和标签,而不会出现重复阶段。

blocks.en: In the end we choose configuration of block_num = 2 (meaning 2 blocks in encoder and decoder parts), hidden_dim =512, c_embed_dim =128, GeLU activations. We removed attention blocks, as even with minimal amount of attention heads model began to overfit and collapsed into few identities. Resulting lightweight model has around 11M parameters, was trained for 1000 epochs with Adam optimizer with constant learning rate set to 0.0003. We applied small inter-batch slerp interpolation between embeddings as augmentation technique. Total training took around 3.5 hours on a single V100 GPU.

blocks.en: In Algorithms 1 and 2 we describe two-stage strategy to match captions of real images with labels of identities. Firstly, we define a finite set of groups that we classify captions into - these groups are mainly defined by age and gender, e.g. adult_male and child_female , and then we collect a final collection of captions for identities by sampling from appropriate group depending on label values of identity. Race labels are intentionally not used for caption matching, so that contextual prompts do not encode race-specific descriptors. This approach has two advantages 1) its algorithmic cost is O ⁡ ( n + m ) O(n+m) , where n n is number of processed captions and m m number of processed labels 2) it allows to avoid heavy cases where captions are not suitable for identity, avoiding synthesizing controversial or unnatural content.
blocks.zh: 在算法1和2中,我们描述了两个阶段的战略,将真实图像的标题与身份标签相匹配。 首先,我们界定了一组有限的群体,我们将其分类为-这些群体主要是按年龄和性别界定的,如成人-男性和子女-女性;然后,我们根据身份的标签价值,从适当群体中取样,收集身份标题的最后资料。 种族标签是故意不用于字幕匹配的,因此背景提示不编码针对种族的描述符. 这种方法有两个优点 1)其算法成本为O QQ (n + m) O(n + m),其中n为已处理字幕数和m为已处理标签数. 2)它允许避免字幕不适合身份的重案,避免将有争议的或非自然的内容合成.

blocks.en: In order to finetune Photomaker we do not rely on shortcut finetuning, but instead follow training recipe described in original paper. We modify collected captions by ensuring trigger-word is added single time next to person descriptor. We finetune LoRA modules attached to linear layers in attention blocks with rank =16 with Adam-W optimizer, learning rate set to 1 ​ e − 5 1e-5 , use linear warm up for approximately 2k iterations and train in total for 20000 iterations with bs =4. In Figure 16 we provide result of finetuning with our dataset - it has a narrower effect of improvement then result for FaceID, which can be attributed to complexity of finetuning task with this model.
blocks.zh: 为了微调相片制作者,我们不依靠快捷方式微调,而是遵循原始纸上描述的训练食谱. 我们修改所收集的标题,确保触发字在人物描述符旁边添加单个时间. 我们用分级=16的注意区块来微调附属于线性地层的LORA模块,将学习速率设定为1 e− 5 1e-5,使用线性热能来进行大约2k的迭接,在20000个迭接中总共进行有bs=4的训练. 在图16中,我们提供了对数据集进行微调的结果——它对FaceID的改进效果较小,这可归因于与这个模型进行微调任务的复杂性。
